items.alt: A petitioner presents community papers before two Supreme Court judges; a red judicial seal interrupts the dotted link between the prior caste certificate and the new Muslim community certificate.
Indian officials hand over a key and deal papers to a Canadian investor in front of an open IDBI Bank vault, while a red market chart falls and paperwork awaits completion.
A Real Madrid player volleys at goal as Roma defenders and their wolf mascot scramble; a scoreboard shows the comeback from 3–1 to 3–4.
A bespectacled tech executive watches a rocket made from stacked financial papers rise with a flattening trail as dark computer chips topple like dominoes.
West Indies batter Shai Hope launches a shot while teammate Keemo Paul celebrates shattered stumps; India’s batter turns back and the series scoreboard reads 2–2.
